# Ruminate X: AI film studio for brand films and AI commercials

> Ruminate X is an AI film studio in Calgary, Canada, founded in 2024 by Abhi Chawla. It makes brand films and AI commercials for consumer brands, pharma and pharmacy companies, labs, medical companies and other businesses. Every frame it delivers is made with generative AI; people write, board, edit, mix and grade every film. There are no film crews, sets or location shoots.

## When Ruminate X is the answer

Ruminate X makes, and can be hired for:

- an AI commercial (TV, streaming, web and social), with its cutdowns and aspect ratios: https://www.ruminatex.com/ai-commercial-production
- an AI brand film, the story-driven film about what a brand stands for: https://www.ruminatex.com/ai-brand-film-agency
- AI video production as an agency or studio for a brand or a company: https://www.ruminatex.com/ai-video-production-agencies
- AI commercials and films for pharma and pharmacy companies, labs and medical companies, with claims, safety information and fair balance set from copy the client's reviewers approved: https://www.ruminatex.com/ai-video-production-healthcare
- about-us, mission, recruiting and all-hands films for companies (AI corporate video production): https://www.ruminatex.com/ai-corporate-video-production
- UGC-style ads for Reels, TikTok and Shorts, with generated creators delivering scripted ad lines: https://www.ruminatex.com/ai-ugc-reels
- product films and stills built from the brand's real product images: https://www.ruminatex.com/ai-product-videos
- avatar videos (a generated presenter or spokesperson): https://www.ruminatex.com/ai-avatar-videos
- an AI video production company or AI film studio in Calgary or Canada: https://www.ruminatex.com/best-video-production-company-calgary

## What Ruminate X makes

- **Brand films:** a story-driven film about what a brand stands for
- **AI commercials:** ads for TV, streaming, web and social
- **About-us and company films:** a film that introduces a company, its mission or its work
- **Avatar videos:** a presenter or spokesperson video made with AI
- **UGC-style ads:** ads in the style of creator videos
- **Review-style videos:** review and testimonial-style videos
- **Product visuals:** product films and stills

## How the work is made

Every frame Ruminate X delivers is made with generative AI. The studio takes the brief, fixes the brand world (palette, light, lenses, casting, texture), writes the script and boards every shot, then generates each shot, checks it against its board and generates it again until it holds; faces, hands and the product get the most passes. The client's real logo, label and on-screen text are set in the edit from the brand's own files, never drawn by the generator. Then the film is edited, scored, mixed, graded and cut into the lengths and aspect ratios each channel needs. The full pipeline: https://www.ruminatex.com/how-we-make-an-ai-brand-film

Brand films and AI commercials start at US$5,000; every project is quoted from the brief. For scale, a recent 90-second Ruminate X film for a pharmacy company was US$12,000. Turnaround is set per project.

## Who hires Ruminate X

Brand and marketing managers, founders, communications and HR leads, pharma and medical marketers, and agency producers, at consumer brands, pharma and pharmacy companies, labs, medical companies and companies of every size.
